title: Online Inference for Quantile Temporal Difference Learning in Distributional Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.12973v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study how to perform statistical inference for quantile temporal difference learning (QTD) in distributional reinforcement learning. Assuming access to a generative model, we first establish functional central limit theorems for both synchronous and asynchronous QTD, which show that the averaged iterates of QTD converge weakly to a rescaled Brownian motion. We next provide online inference methods. Based on random scaling, the inference procedure constructs an asymptotically pivotal statistic for inference by using the information along the whole QTD path. Meanwhile, the proposed statistic can be computed online without storing the entire trajectory of QTD iterates. This substantially reduces the memory requirement and enables efficient statistical inference in distributional reinforcement learning.

translated_title: 分布强化学习中分位数时序差分学习的在线推断
translated_abstract: 本文研究了分布强化学习中分位数时序差分学习（QTD）的统计推断方法。假设可以访问生成模型，我们首先为同步和异步QTD建立了泛函中心极限定理，表明QTD的平均迭代弱收敛于一个重新缩放的布朗运动。接着，我们提供了在线推断方法。基于随机缩放，该推断过程利用整个QTD路径上的信息构建了一个渐近枢轴统计量进行推断。同时，所提出的统计量可以在线计算，无需存储QTD迭代的完整轨迹。这大大降低了内存需求，并实现了分布强化学习中的高效统计推断。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机缩放的在线推断方法，通过泛函中心极限定理支持，在不存储完整轨迹的情况下对分布强化学习中的QTD进行统计推断，显著减少了内存需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online inference method based on random scaling, supported by functional central limit theorems, enabling statistical inference for QTD in distributional reinforcement learning without storing the full trajectory, significantly reducing memory requirements.
